$comment: GENERATED FILE - do not edit. Rendered by host/sim/neon_screens.cpp through the firmware's own render_ui(). Regenerate: cmake --build build-host --target neon_screens && ./build-host/neon_screens > design/screens.json
format: base64 of the raw framebuffer: 16 pages x 128 columns, one byte = 8 vertical pixels, LSB is the topmost row

screens.title: Live — first boot
screens.note: No Link session yet: the hero shows its placeholder rather than a tempo the module is not running at.

screens.title: Live — setup access point
screens.note: The strongest moment of cohesion: the address on the panel is the address you open the web UI at.

screens.title: Live — running, two peers
screens.note: While playing the panel fills with the current beat. Phase 1.5 of a 4-beat bar is beat 2: black numeral on a white field.

screens.title: Live — beat 1
screens.note: Odd beat: largest white numeral inside a 2 px black border.

screens.title: Live — beat 2
screens.note: Even beat: the panel inverts — black numeral, white field.

screens.title: Live — beat 3
screens.note: Odd beat: largest white numeral inside a 2 px black border.

screens.title: Live — beat 4
screens.note: Even beat: the panel inverts — black numeral, white field.

screens.title: Live — running, classic layout
screens.note: Big beat numbers can be turned off; the BPM home screen returns.

screens.title: Header — beat 1
screens.note: Link pulses on the beat; the radio marks run on the 5 Hz tick.

screens.title: Header — beat 2
screens.note: Link pulses on the beat; the radio marks run on the 5 Hz tick.

screens.title: Header — beat 3
screens.note: Link pulses on the beat; the radio marks run on the 5 Hz tick.

screens.title: Header — beat 4
screens.note: Link pulses on the beat; the radio marks run on the 5 Hz tick.

screens.title: Live — stopped
screens.note: The phase fill goes half-tone when the transport is stopped, so a held position is visibly not advancing.

screens.title: Live — external clock
screens.note: External clock drives the session; the source word changes and the rest of the layout holds still.

screens.title: Live — no network
screens.note: No access point and no network joined: the header carries the warning icon and the state row reads OFF.

screens.title: Menu
screens.note: Five destinations, one level deep. Long press is the way back from anywhere.

screens.title: Outputs
screens.note: The four clock outputs.

screens.title: Clock 1 — browsing
screens.note: A caret marks focus while the encoder is moving the cursor.

screens.title: Clock 1 — editing PPQN
screens.note: The row inverts while the encoder is changing a value, so the knob's mode is never ambiguous.

screens.title: Network
screens.note: Read-only. Credentials need a keyboard, so they live in the web UI and the panel points you at it.

screens.title: MIDI / BLE
screens.note: Routing that is worth reaching without a phone.

screens.title: Audio
screens.note: The metronome, what each output jack carries, and whether the mix is published over Link Audio.

screens.title: System
screens.note: Timing offsets, clock source and reboot.

screens.title: Confirm — default
screens.note: Destructive actions get a confirmation screen, defaulting to NO.

screens.title: Confirm — YES selected
screens.note: The selected choice is inverted; there is no colour to fall back on here.
